visual_action: The video opens with a title card reading "a cool edit of trump" on a blue background. It then cuts to a rapid montage of still photos and short clips of Donald Trump. These include a close-up of his face with a glowing effect, him speaking animatedly at a podium with a yellow tint, a throwback photo of him lounging on a bed in a white robe, him wearing a "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hat and sticking his tongue out, and another expressive close-up. A brief, blurry clip shows a man in a suit, seen from behind, walking up the stairs to an airplane. The video ends with a blurry shot with sparkles and a final close-up of someone's bare feet in white trousers standing on a textured white surface.
